stemMd: A function satisfies $f(x)=2x-7$. If $g(x)=f(x+4)-3$, what is $g(0)$?
explanationMd: Substitute before simplifying: g(0)=f(4)−3=(8−7)−3=−2. Alternatively g(x)=2x−2.

distractorRationale.c: This evaluates f(4) but omits the final subtraction.
distractorRationale.d: This retains only the shifted linear term.
distractorRationale.a: This ignores the shift inside f.
